summary: First Financial Bankshares filed an 8-K announcing its board renewed and increased its share repurchase plan. The plan now authorizes up to 7.2 million shares (about 5% of outstanding) through July 31, 2027, up from 5.0 million. Repurchases may occur on the open market, in block trades, or privately, with timing subject to market conditions and Federal Reserve non-objection. The plan has no minimum purchase obligation and may be suspended anytime. This is a capital return event, not a tender offer—watch for opportunistic buybacks at attractive prices, with regulatory oversight a key constraint.
